trainingLoss: Three complete native phonetic CTC sequence negative log likelihoods, normalized by sequence target length for gradient averaging only; CPU float64 dynamic program with MPS gradients.
labels: Provided realized pinyin only, including neutral T5; no Hanzi conversion or forced word crops. Unsupported phonetic tokens quarantine the whole training utterance with explicit counts.
checkpointSelection: OMPAL v2 calibration balanced expert signed single-label CTC loss; no OMPAL gradient updates and no final audio.
